summary1: Welcome to my personal website! I am Rithwik Gokhale, a forward-deployed engineer and industrial AI practitioner who bridges the gap between heavy industry and the future of autonomous operations.
summary2: I'm a Computer Engineering grad with a Data Science minor from Iowa State University, working at the intersection of industrial operations, data contextualization, and agentic AI. I thrive on taking complex, messy real-world problems—the kind you find in refineries, pharma plants, and biofuel facilities—and turning them into scalable, evidence-grounded solutions.
summary3: At Adatafy, I operate as a forward-deployed engineer embedded with clients across Pharma, Biofuels, and Agriculture. I own the full arc from discovery workshop to live deployment: architecting OT/IT data integrations, designing industrial data models, building automation tooling in Python, and leading executive-level stakeholder alignment. Every engagement is a pre-sales and delivery hybrid—I build confidence through working prototypes and reference demos before a single contract line is signed.
summary4: I have hands-on experience with the "messiness" that makes industrial data hard: millisecond-aligned sensor streams, offline-resilient edge systems, regulatory audit trails, and legacy PLC/SCADA environments. I've connected MES platforms (Shiftconnector, Augmentir, Inmation) to SAP/ERP systems and built the integration middleware that makes siloed OT and IT data actually useful to operators and analysts.
summary5: On the AI front, I build evidence-grounded copilots and agentic solutions for industrial workflows. My PharmaOps Copilot project demonstrates an LLM-powered deviation triage agent that assembles a deterministic evidence packet—events, time series anomalies, work orders, SOP references—before any model reasoning occurs, ensuring every response is traceable and safe for human-reviewed operations. I work fluently across the GenAI stack: RAG pipelines, prompt chaining, LLM orchestration, and guardrail design for mission-critical environments.
summary6: In previous roles at NVIDIA and Dolby, I built XR prototypes for CloudXR medical training use cases and led Agile-driven enterprise project management. These experiences sharpened my ability to pivot between deep engineering sessions and C-level strategy briefings—a skill I use every week in client engagements.
summary7: I'm energized by the challenge of unlocking value from industrial data at scale—and excited about the potential of platforms like Cognite Data Fusion to make that vision real. Let's connect if you're building the future of industrial AI.
